hypotheses.justification: Split on whether u is nonempty, using the existing proof in the nonempty case. If u = ∅, its partition sum is zero, so Real.log_zero makes polytopeSoftSupport identically zero and polytopeRoundedSupport identically rho. This constant support is smooth, and deriv_const' shows its curvature radius is rho > 0. Thus smoothSupportCurve_regular proves the conclusion in the empty case too.
